defect: A response arriving after the verified identity changed or disappeared could be accepted; reads returned records and prepare responses advanced local state before the next authentication check.
fix: Revalidate the bound identity after transport returns and before consuming the response. On failure invalidate the observed record version, retain any uncertain attempt, and raise a constant error. No retries or execute calls are added.
new_conditions: Delayed read response is rejected after a synthetic principal change; no result returned and observed version remains unset.
Delayed read response is rejected after native identity disappears; no result returned and observed version remains unset.
Delayed prepare response after principal change leaves PREPARING with no operation binding, sends no execute and creates no business audit.
Unchanged synthetic identity still completes save and readback with one audit.

safety.network_transport: local Node subprocess with fictional in-memory fixture only

limitations: Timing changes were injected in offline transport, not observed in production or isolated live infrastructure.
Identity validation relies on the native provider; this change does not prove live logout, key rotation or ACL behavior.
Local SQLite remains a regression store, not an approved durable Streamlit store.
Old-key signature rejection, approved live recovery, durable sixty-minute observation and formal QA remain incomplete.
Live 165 rows and audit were not remeasured; no live environment was accessed.
No deployment or independent technical/QA approval is claimed.
continuation: Do not repeat these tests as new UAT progress. Recovery candidates remain undeployed; retain communication stop. Review other response/state boundaries only where a new defect is demonstrated.
